title: Extremal separation times and clade-count dynamics in fragmentation trees: a freezing transition
summary: Motivated by the continuous-time critical beta-splitting tree, we investigate chronological trees recording the successive block splits and their times in homogeneous fragmentation processes restricted to $n$ labels. The separation time of a subset is the first time its labels cease to lie in a common block. For each fixed integer $q\geq2$, we study extremal separation times of $q$-element subsets via their associated point process.
